Hi Alex / Priya — thanks for the 30m earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

Call recap
- Use case: in-app summarization + secure embeddings for clinical notes (pilot scoped to 5k users)
- Success metric: 20% reduction in triage time on pilot cohort; latency SLOs: p50 < 120ms
- Integration: server-side API calls to private deployment (VPC) — security is a gating item

Asks / next steps
1) Budget + econ buyer: could you confirm who owns the budget for this initiative and who we should loop in for commercial approval?
2) Procurement timeline: what procurement/legal milestones do you have and rough dates (PO, contract review, security questionnaire)?
3) Security contacts: who on your side should we send SOC2 and data-handling docs to?
4) Pilot proposal: permission to share a 1-page pilot SOW and pricing for review (attached recap & SOC2 summary included).

If you prefer, I can send a short proposal that Priya or whoever owns the budget can circulate internally. Happy to jump on a follow-up with your procurement/security folks next week — available Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Attachments: redwood-call-recap-FluxHealth.pdf; SOC2-summary.pdf
